brand.name: Stripe
brand.summary: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform that helps businesses of all sizes accept online and in-person payments, manage billing models, and handle global money movement. It provides flexible APIs, developer tools, and enterprise-grade solutions to scale digital commerce.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: Stripe is a market-leading financial services platform powering global commerce, offering robust payment processing, billing, fraud prevention, and embedded financial tools for startups and enterprise businesses.

competitors.name: PayPal
competitors.main_service: Digital wallet and online payment processing
competitors.target_market: Consumers and merchants of all sizes
competitors.key_strength: High brand recognition and consumer trust
competitors.weakness_or_gap: Less developer-centric customization compared to Stripe
competitors.opportunity: Target developers seeking advanced API integrations and flexible custom revenue models

competitors.name: Adyen
competitors.main_service: Global payment gateway and acquiring services
competitors.key_strength: Unified single-platform architecture for global enterprise scale
competitors.weakness_or_gap: Higher barrier to entry for smaller startups and SMBs
competitors.opportunity: Highlight user-friendly startup onboarding and no-code tools to capture fast-growing companies

competitors.name: Square
competitors.main_service: POS hardware and integrated payment solutions
competitors.target_market: Small businesses, retail, and brick-and-mortar stores
competitors.key_strength: Strong ecosystem of physical point-of-sale hardware and software
competitors.weakness_or_gap: Historically less optimized for complex enterprise SaaS and global developer stacks
competitors.opportunity: Promote advanced software extensibility and developer APIs for tech-forward businesses
